key_insight: Hierarchical quantum error correction spans both cooperating decoder stages and multilevel code constructions, with distinct throughput, latency, and coordination trade-offs.
engineering_relevance: Practical fault-tolerant systems must match decoder architecture and hardware to syndrome workloads and end-to-end correction deadlines.
method: Review cascaded, windowed, streaming, and distributed decoding.
Compare cross-level information exchange and CPU, GPU, FPGA, ASIC, and cryogenic platforms.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes a literature-based comparison under reported evaluation conditions, without presenting numerical benchmarks or a new experimental validation.
watch_item: Gaps in performance reporting and system integration limit direct comparisons and confidence in deployment readiness.
paper_title: Hierarchical Decoding for Quantum Error Correction
